questions.stem: ________ he is ill, ________ he goes to school.
questions.expl: 句意：尽管他生病了，他还是去上学了。 考查连词辨析。although 尽管，引导让步状语从句；but 但是，表转折。根据“…he is ill…he goes to school.”可知，前半句与后半句为让步关系，应用although 引导让步状语从句，且不能与but 一起 连用。故选C。

questions.stem: It's wise of young people to avoid __________the same mistakes again and again.
questions.expl: 句意：年轻人避免犯同样的错误是明智的。考查动名词作宾语。avoid：避免；避开，躲 避，及物动词，其后可接名词、代词或动名词作宾语。结合句意可知填making；选C。

questions.stem: I think Guangzhou is as ________ as Beijing.
questions.expl: 句意：我认为广州和北京一样漂亮。 考查形容词的原级比较。“as+原级+as”意思是“和……一样”。故选A。

questions.stem: You may contact John on 3364-8830 for ________ information.
questions.expl: 句意：如需更多信息，请致电3364-8830 与约翰联系。A. far 远的；B. farther 更远的，指 路程上更远；C. further 更多的，更进一步的，指数量上或程度上更……；D. furthest 最大程度的， 最远的。故C 选项符合题意。

questions.stem: —Now I know how to do these things well by ________.—So you don’t have to ________ your parents.
questions.expl: 句意：——现在我知道如何自己把这些事情做好了。——所以你不必依赖你的父母。 考查代词辨析和动词短语。me 我，宾格；myself 我自己，反身代词。根据“I know how to do these things well by”可知是自己做事情，用反身代词；depend on“依靠”，动词短语。故选C。

questions.stem: English is spoken by________people in the world.
questions.expl: 句意：世界上有很多人讲英语。 A. a large number of 很多，大量的，修饰可数名词复数；B. the number of……的总数； C. huge amounts of 大量的，修饰不可数名词；D. the great number of……的大数目。people 本身为复数名词， 此处指很多人，故选A。

questions.stem: Mr Li is always strict ________ our studies and never makes fun ________ us.
questions.expl: 句意：李老师对我们的学习总是很严格，而且从不取笑我们。 考查介词辨析。in 在……里面；about 关于、大约；with 和……一起；of……的。be strict about/in sth.“对 某事要求严格”，be strict with sb.“对某人要求严格”，“our studies”指的是事物，因此用be strict about/in sth，排除B 选项；make fun of sb“取笑某人”，固定词组，排除A、C 选项；故选D。

questions.stem: Students have many problems._______, they often feel worried before an exam.
questions.expl: 句意：学生们有很多难题。例如，他们经常在考试前感到担心。For instance 例如，用逗 号和句子隔开；Such as 例如，列举多个例子；是对前面某个词的举例；Like 像，As for 关于。此 处列举问题，有逗号隔开，故用for instance。故选A。

questions.stem: —I want to know why Mr. Chen divided us _________ four groups?—_____ doubt, he wants to try out for the group teaching.
questions.expl: 句意：——我想知道陈先生为什么把我们分成四组？——毫无疑问，他想尝试小组教学。 考查介词辨析。into 到……里面；For 为了；on 在上面；In 在里面；Without 无，没有；at 在；To 到。divide into“分成”，动词短语。without doubt“毫无疑问”。故选C。

questions.stem: When I arrived home, I noticed my sister ________ with her toys.
A．weight
questions.expl: ：但是你有没有想过书包的历史？ weight 重量；history 历史；shape 形状；color 颜色。根据下文“In the Han Dynasty”可知，此处说的 是“书包的历史”。故选B。

questions.stem: A．most famous
questions.expl: ：人们认为竹盒是最早的书包。

questions.stem: A．an bag
questions.expl: ：盒子里通常有两三层。 an bag 一个包；pocket 口袋；hole 洞；box 盒子。根据“bamboo boxes”可知，盒子里通常有两三层。 故选D。

questions.stem: A．However
questions.expl: ：例如，在《白蛇传》中，许仕林带着一个竹制的箱子去京城参加考试。 However 然而；Moreover 此外；That is 那是；For example 例如。根据“in the Legend of the White Snake, Xu Shilin carries a bamboo box to the capital to take an exam.”可知，此处举了一个例子。故选D。

questions.stem: A．before
questions.expl: ：数百年后，人们发明了一种新的书包，叫做“布袋”，或“腰包”。 before 在……之前；later 之后；ago 之前；after 在……之后。根据“people developed a new kind of schoolbags called the ‘budai’, or the ‘hip-pocket’.”可知，这是数百年后的书包。故选B。

questions.stem: A．experiences
questions.expl: ：也许他们可以告诉你他们在学校的时候背着他们的经历。 experiences 经历；pictures 图片；invention 发明；dreams 梦想。根据“…carrying them when they were in school.”可知，此处指的是“他们的经历”。故选A。

questions.stem: A．produced
questions.expl: ：近年来出现了一种新样式的书包。 produced生产；came来；appeared出现；lost失去。根据“A new style of schoolbags has…in recent years.” 可知，近年来出现了一种新样式的书包。故选C。

questions.stem: A．people
questions.expl: ：它们中的许多上面有色彩鲜艳、时尚的图案，比如卡通或流行明星的图片。 people 人们；wheels 车轮；designs 图案；words 话。根据“such as pictures of cartoons or pop stars.” 可知，此处指的是时尚的图案。故选C。

questions.stem: A．covered
questions.expl: ：一些学生拉着装满沉重课本的带轮书包，其他人背着背包。 covered 覆盖；filled 充满；carried 携带；poured 倒出。根据“…with heavy textbooks and others carry backpacks.”可知，书包里装满了这些书本。故选B。

questions.stem: A．how
questions.expl: ：你能想象未来的书包会是什么样子吗？ how 怎样；when 什么时候；which 哪个；that 那个。根据“Can you imagine…future schoolbags will be like?”可知，此处指的是“你能想象未来的书包会是什么样子吗？”，因此用how 引导。故选A。

questions.stem: What can we know from the first paragraph?
opts: Ben was born in a poor family.
Ben was the only child of the family.
Ben was not interested in inventing.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第一段“there was not enough money for his education”可知，家里没有足够的 钱供他上学，说明他家境贫困。故选B。

questions.stem: How did the invention of the Franklin stove help us?
opts: It helped us buy more warm houses.
It helped us read more books.
It helped us save wood and keep safer.
It helped us save some time to heat.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第二段“The Franklin stove used less wood and was safer to heat the room.”可知， 富兰克林炉用更少的木材，且取暖更安全。故选C。

questions.stem: What does the third paragraph tell us?
questions.expl: 大意题。根据第三段“What’s more, Ben was interested in electricity.”可知，富兰克林对电感 兴趣，随后描述他通过风筝实验证明闪电是电的过程；因此，本段讲述了富兰克林与电的相关事情。

questions.stem: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Ben kept his inventions to himself.
Ben went to school for only a year.
Ben did badly in his study.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据第三段“he finally had a plan to prove that lightning was electricity and he was successful at last in the kite experiment”可知，他终于想出了一个方案来证明闪电就是电。最终，他 在风筝实验中取得了成功；据此可以推断，富兰克林做了风筝实验。故选D。

questions.stem: Why did the writer write the passage?
opts: To tell us to learn more at school.
To tell us a famous inventor.
To encourage us to invent something.
questions.expl: 大意题。综合全文可知，本文通篇围绕本杰明・富兰克林的生平、发明展开，核心是“介绍 这位著名的发明家”。故选C。

questions.stem: How did people travel in ancient times?
opts: On foot or by riding animals.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“In ancient times, people mainly traveled on foot or by riding animals like horses.” 可知，古代人们步行或骑动物出行，故选C。

questions.stem: What invention changed transportation after ancient times?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Then, the invention of the wheel changed transportation.”可知，轮子的发明在 古代之后改变了交通，故选C。

questions.stem: What became popular after the invention of the steam engine?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“In the 19th century, the steam engine was invented. Trains and steamships became popular.”可知，蒸汽机发明后，火车和蒸汽船流行起来，故选B。

questions.stem: What is the advantage of high-speed trains?
opts: They can carry the most people.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Airplanes made long-distance travel much faster. Now, high-speed trains are also becoming more and more common in many countries.”和“People can travel to different places more easily”，飞机让长途旅行更快，而高铁也在国家中变得更加常见，交通方式的发展让世界变得更小， 可推断其优势是让长途旅行更快，故选C。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.expl: 大意题。根据文章标题“The Development of Transportation”以及全文对不同时期交通方式 的介绍可知，本文主要讲的是交通发展的历史，故选A。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly talking about?
opts: A new AI model can solve math problems.
The difference between Chinese AI and American’s.
Chinese AI Model DeepSeek-R1 stuns (震惊) the World.
questions.expl: 大意题。根据文章整体内容，介绍了中国科技公司开发的DeepSeek-R1 人工智能，包括 其功能、研发优势、影响等，是说该AI 震撼世界，可知本文主要讲中国AI 模型DeepSeek-R1 震

questions.stem: What does “good ideas can beat big money” mean in Paragraph1?
opts: Big money is the main thing for success, and good ideas are less important.
Good ideas can be more useful than having a lot of money.
Good ideas can only work when used with a lot of money.
Good ideas and big money are both important.

questions.stem: What can we learn from the passage?
opts: DeepSeek-R1 can only solve math problems and answer questions.
DeepSeek-R1 learns by trying many times and getting better, not like how students practice maths.
Compared with other AIs which need lots of prepared examples, R1 improves by itself.
On R1’s third day online, over 19,000 programmers worldwide started projects to study it.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“How It Learns”部分“Other AIs need lots of prepared examples, but R1 improves by itself.”可知，与需要大量准备好的示例的其他AI 相比，R1 能自我提升，故选C。

questions.stem: How much do the German scientist’s experiments with R1 cost?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Free for Everyone”部分“A German scientist said experiments with R1 only cost $10”，可知，德国科学家用R1 做实验花费10 美元，故选C。

questions.stem: Why is DeepSeek-R1 called a “big step forward”?
opts: It proves (证明) that smart ideas beat expensive tools.
It uses the most expensive tools.
It made U.S. tech companies worried.
It can only help rich people.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Big Reactions(反应)”部分“A report in Nature magazine called R1 a ‘big step forward.’ showing that smart ideas beat expensive tools.”可知，因为它证明了聪明的创意胜过昂贵的工 具，所以被称为“big step forward”，故选A。
